name: medium-research-mastodon
description: Mastodon instance research with normalized MCP output. Keyless — no credentials and no user_config: the target instance is a per-call `instance` tool parameter (scheme defaults to https), so this server hardcodes no instance host. Tools: mastodon_public, mastodon_hashtag, mastodon_trending_tags, mastodon_trending_links. A locked-down instance (anonymous reads disabled) yields a clear tool-level error; an instance with trends disabled returns an empty result set, never an error. Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.
